name: Slider
description: A range slider rendered as a native <input type='range'>. Styled track and thumb use CSS vendor-prefixed pseudo-elements. The filled portion hint uses color-action-primary. Keyboard arrow key interaction is provided natively by the browser.

notes: aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow are provided natively by the range input.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.
Disabled state reduces opacity and sets cursor: not-allowed.
Thumb meets the 44x44px minimum touch target via min-block-size and min-inline-size.
Always provide an accessible name via aria-label or by associating with a visible label.

value.description: Current value. Use with onChange for controlled usage.

onChange.description: Callback fired with the numeric value when the slider changes.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the wrapper div.

do: Always provide an accessible name via aria-label or a visible label element with htmlFor.
Pair with a visible value display so users know the exact current value.
Use step values that produce a clean set of options for the context (e.g., step=5 for percentages).
dont: Do not use for precise numeric entry — use an Input type='number' instead or alongside.
Do not omit a label — range inputs have no implicit accessible name.
Do not rely on colour alone to communicate the filled portion.
